decision.observation: 8:10 am; the farmer stands east of the bush line at ~(0.72,0.42), beside the stump, with the pond's rim and water directly below (water from y~0.60, x 0.55-0.95). Pole selected.
decision.hypothesis: Casting south from this clear spot should land the bobber in the pond, enabling a bite and catch as on days 5-6.
decision.memory: Fishing loop: face water, hold C to cast, press C at the bobber dip; if the bar minigame opens, LMB holds/releases keep the green bar on the fish. Catches: Sunfish, Joja Cola x2.
